```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
risk <- eligible_risk_set(collect(tbl(con, "outcomes")))
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
status_tab <- risk |>
  count(status_end_of_season, name = "seasons") |>
  mutate(
    share = seasons / sum(seasons),
    status_label = recode(
      status_end_of_season,
      "continuing" = "Still playing next season",
      "exhausted_undrafted" = "Exhausted eligibility undrafted",
      "left_data" = "Gone the next season, reason unknown",
      "signed_udfa" = "Signed as an undrafted free agent",
      "drafted" = "Drafted"
    ),
    route = case_when(
      status_end_of_season == "drafted" ~ "drafted",
      status_end_of_season == "signed_udfa" ~ "undrafted",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    status_label = reorder(status_label, share)
  )
p_continuing <- status_tab$share[status_tab$status_end_of_season == "continuing"]

p <- ggplot(status_tab, aes(x = 100 * share, y = status_label)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = route,
      tooltip = sprintf("%s: %s seasons (%.1f%%)", status_label, fmt(seasons), 100 * share),
      data_id = status_label
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * share)),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 5.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(drafted = "#1B9E77", undrafted = "#7570B3", other = "grey65"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = 100 * p_continuing + 15) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "How eligible seasons end",
    subtitle = "Share of eligible player-seasons by end-of-season status; drafted in green, signed undrafted in purple",
    x = "Share of eligible seasons",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "end-of-season-status", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-eligible-season
status_idx <- risk |>
  count(eligible_season_index, status_end_of_season, name = "n") |>
  group_by(eligible_season_index) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n), seasons = sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(seasons >= 100) |>
  left_join(
    distinct(status_tab, status_end_of_season, status_label),
    by = "status_end_of_season"
  ) |>
  mutate(status_label = factor(status_label, levels = levels(status_tab$status_label)))
p_idx <- ggplot(
  status_idx,
  aes(factor(eligible_season_index), 100 * share, fill = status_label)
) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "Eligible season %d, %s: %.1f%% (%s of %s seasons)",
        eligible_season_index,
        status_label,
        100 * share,
        fmt(n),
        fmt(seasons)
      ),
      data_id = paste(eligible_season_index, status_label)
    ),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "How eligible seasons end, by eligible season number",
    subtitle = "Share of eligible seasons by end-of-season status",
    x = "Eligible season number",
    y = "Share of eligible seasons (%)",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Eligible seasons with fewer than 100 player-seasons omitted. Hover a segment for the count."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
card_interactive(p_idx)
```
